headlines.title: Monolithic (MPWR) Upgraded to Buy: What Does It Mean for the Stock?
headlines.summary: Monolithic (MPWR) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), reflecting growing optimism about the company's earnings prospects. This might drive the stock higher in the near term.

headlines.title: Here's What to Expect From Monolithic Power Systems' Next Earnings Report

headlines.title: Monolithic Power Systems, MACOM, Micron, Seagate, and Vishay Intertechnology Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know

headlines.title: How Record Data-Center Sales And Margin Gains At Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) Have Changed Its Investment Story
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems recently reported record quarterly revenue of US$980.6 million, driven by strong enterprise data demand and over 1,500 new automotive product introductions, while lifting its operating margin to 31% from 24.8% with largely unchanged gross margin.

headlines.title: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) Could Be 25% Undervalued As Record Revenue Fuels Debate
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) is back in focus after reporting record quarterly revenue, driven by enterprise data demand and a surge of new automotive products that has drawn heavier institutional trading interest. After a sharp breakout earlier in the year and a more recent consolidation, Monolithic Power Systems now trades at US$1,386.29, with a 30-day share price return of 16.88% and a 1-year total shareholder return of 54.30%.

description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. provides semiconductor-based power electronics solutions in China, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Japan, and internationally. The company offers direct current (DC) to DC solutions to convert and control voltages within a range of electronic systems, such as cloud-based and on-premises CPU servers and workstations, AI systems, memory, storage solutions, notebooks, infotainment, power sources, home appliances, network infrastructure, and satellite communications. It also provides alternating current (AC) to DC; driver metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors; power management integrated circuits (ICs); and current limit switch and lighting control products. The company serves storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, communications, consumer, and industrial end markets through third-party distributors and value-added resellers. Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in West Palm Beach, Florida.
